# Ported from Angora_original/llvm_mode/external_lib/zlib_abilist.txt: of
# all zlib functions, Angora gives *only* crc32 a precise custom model
# (every other zlib function -- inflate/deflate/gz* -- is `discard`, same
# as this build's auto-generated ANGORA_TAINT_RULE_LIST). See
# runtime/dtaint_legacy_hooks.c's __dfsw_crc32 (ported from
# external_lib/zlib_func.c) for the implementation. Kept as its own file
# (rather than folded into the auto-generated per-target discard list) so
# it isn't accidentally overwritten by that generator if crc32 ever also
# matches its own "everything this target links against" sweep -- the
# Dockerfile explicitly excludes `fun:crc32=` from that generated list.
fun:crc32=custom
